plan.title: Bubble, arrows, slush, spots, harbour drawing

events.text: Give me a meteor slapshot on F, instead of the bubble and the green-spot tricks. Press F to light my stick on fire, then hold shoot to wind it up: the longer I hold, the harder it flies, and while I wind up I am easy to knock over. Released, the puck flies twice as fast as a normal shot, trails fire and smoke, and knocks down every skater it passes, rivals, mates and the keeper alike, with a flash, a boom, a short freeze and a camera kick. When it goes in, the net bulges and the glass shakes. It comes back 12 seconds after I use it. The rival bots should try a meteor of their own from distance, and dive in front of mine to block it.

events.text:
- RULE: not done. This is the part that changes how the match plays: F as a meteor in place of the bubble, coming back 12 seconds after use, with no green-spot tricks. It needs `data/harbour.cartridge.json`, which is outside my scope. The owner of that file needs to make `game.abilities` one `shotgun` entry with trigger `mode`, unlimited charges (charges 0, if the core treats 0 as unlimited) and `cooldown_frames` 720, and remove the two pickup trick entries.
- RULE: not done, and the cartridge has no key for it. These rules are not buildable as data: winding up longer for a harder shot, being easier to knock over while winding up, flying twice as fast as a normal shot, and knocking down every skater the puck passes, mates and keeper included. On the cartridge, the core's `shotgun` shot uses `magnitude` (now 1.5); 2.0 would come closest to "twice as fast". Who it knocks down is decided by the core.
- RULE: not done. The rival bots trying a meteor from distance and diving in front of yours are bot decisions inside the core. No file in my scope can change them, and the contract forbids bot code.
- The short freeze is not added. The core's own hit-stop stays, and I held no extra pose frames.
- The net bulge and glass shake on a meteor goal are drawn as a flash at the puck plus a 0.3 m camera kick. The net and the glass belong to the base's arena, so they do not move.
- Shake rule widened: the camera now also kicks when any skater is knocked down by the shot in flight, and harder on a goal right after that shot. The old rule was "only your knockdown or a goal". The new values are in `data/tuning.json` at `harbour.meteor` (kick_m 0.15, goal_kick_m 0.3, kick_f 10).
- The bubble, green-spot and hip-check drawing stays, because the match still gives those tricks. New moment kind: `meteor_flatten` (frame list).
- KIT: none added or removed.
- Not run: `tests/bot_match_hand.gd`, because time ran out. `main.gd` and the base's match code are unchanged.
